aggregator_payment_terminal.question: Electronic Fawry/aggregator payment has not appeared.
aggregator_payment_terminal.finding: The training SLA reference lists 48 working hours for Aggregators Payment Not Clear. Verify the channel and current SLA.
aggregator_payment_terminal.action: Check the receipt, transaction ID, channel, and paid-to number. Log the correct payment complaint in TTS and use its current SLA. Never request a full card number or OTP.
aggregator_payment_terminal.customer_script: I will check the receipt and transaction details and log the right complaint. My training reference lists 48 working hours for this channel; I will confirm the SLA shown when the request is created.

balance_fraction_terminal.finding: The training reference lists Balance Fraction as available on the spot for eligible customers; confirm eligibility and any limit in the current system.

balance_fraction_terminal.customer_script: I will check whether the line is eligible for a balance fraction and the current limit, then tell you whether service can be restored immediately.
balance_fraction_terminal.sla: Immediate per training reference; confirm current eligibility

promise_to_pay_start.question: What account type does the system show?

promise_to_pay_consumer_terminal.question: Promise to Pay — Consumer Postpaid account.
promise_to_pay_consumer_terminal.finding: The day 10 training guide lists a 24-hour temporary restoration for eligible Consumer customers, once in the service lifecycle and for arrears. Verify current terms.
promise_to_pay_consumer_terminal.action: Check eligibility and whether the service has already used this option during its lifecycle. Process only if the current system offers it and the reason matches To Arrears.
promise_to_pay_consumer_terminal.customer_script: I will check eligibility for temporary restoration and confirm its duration and terms before proceeding.
promise_to_pay_consumer_terminal.sla: Training reference: 24 hours for eligible customers; verify current duration
promise_to_pay_consumer_terminal.reference_guidance: From day_10.pdf (dated training): once per Life Cycle for To Arrears. Verify current procedure.

promise_to_pay_nonconsumer_terminal.question: Promise to Pay — Non-Consumer account.
promise_to_pay_nonconsumer_terminal.finding: The day 10 training guide lists a 48-hour temporary restoration for eligible Non-Consumer customers, once in the service lifecycle and for arrears. Verify current terms.
promise_to_pay_nonconsumer_terminal.action: Check account type, eligibility, and whether the service has already used this option during its lifecycle. Process only if the current system offers it and the reason matches To Arrears.
promise_to_pay_nonconsumer_terminal.customer_script: I will check whether the account qualifies for temporary restoration and confirm its duration and terms before proceeding.
promise_to_pay_nonconsumer_terminal.sla: Training reference: 48 hours for eligible customers; verify current duration
promise_to_pay_nonconsumer_terminal.reference_guidance: From day_10.pdf (dated training): once per Life Cycle for To Arrears. Verify current procedure.

promise_to_pay_unknown_terminal.question: Account type is unclear.
promise_to_pay_unknown_terminal.finding: Account classification has not been verified, so Promise to Pay eligibility cannot be determined.
promise_to_pay_unknown_terminal.action: Check the account type in the current system first. Do not assume Consumer or Non-Consumer status.
promise_to_pay_unknown_terminal.customer_script: I will confirm the account type and available terms, then explain the appropriate option.
promise_to_pay_unknown_terminal.sla: Do not promise a duration until verified

assia_start.question: In ASSIA, is the line Supported, and is Collection Date today?
assia_start.customer_prompt: I will check the ASSIA result first, then explain the next step.

options.label: Supported and Collection Date is today; check Clear View
Supported but Collection Date is not today; run Clear View and verify Last fix within 24 hours

assia_result.question: What result appears in Clear View?

options.label: A relevant Physical Layer issue or Fault appears
No DSL Physical-Layer issue is detected

assia_physical_terminal.question: Result: Clear View shows a Physical Layer indicator.
assia_physical_terminal.finding: A Physical Layer indicator is present; match the Fault to the customer symptoms before classifying.
assia_physical_terminal.action: Follow the advice for the matching Fault. For a Physical Instability complaint, run ASSIA Clear View and verify Last fix within 24 hours before escalation. Log the correct complaint and attach a screenshot when required.
assia_physical_terminal.customer_script: I found an indicator on the line. I will try the relevant steps with you. If a follow-up ticket is needed, I will give you its reference and the SLA shown in the system.
assia_physical_terminal.sla: Depends on complaint type in TTS; verify before promising
assia_physical_terminal.reference_guidance: Give the actual TT/SR reference if created and required; IR is internal.

assia_logical_terminal.question: Clear View result: No DSL Physical-Layer issue is detected. What does the ADSL light do during the disconnection?
assia_logical_terminal.finding: This result alone does not detect a Physical Layer fault or prove a logical cause; use the light status to choose the next path.
assia_logical_terminal.customer_prompt: When the internet drops, does the ADSL light stay steady or go off?

options.label: ADSL stays steady during the disconnection

assia_not_supported.question: Result: line is Not Supported by ASSIA.
assia_not_supported.finding: ASSIA does not support this line; do not infer a fault type from this alone.
assia_not_supported.action: Ask whether the ADSL light stays on or goes off during an internet disconnection. Steady: follow Logical Instability. Goes off: follow Physical Instability. Use approved alternative tools.
assia_not_supported.customer_script: This tool does not support the line, so I will identify the disconnection type from the ADSL light and continue the relevant checks.

options.label: ADSL stays steady during the disconnection

assia_unknown_terminal.question: Clear View result is unclear or does not match known cases.
assia_unknown_terminal.finding: Physical/Logical cause is not confirmed from available data.
assia_unknown_terminal.action: Do not guess the classification. Review the complete Clear View output and current tools, then use the approved support path if still unclear.
assia_unknown_terminal.customer_script: The result needs another check. I will verify the line details and continue with a confirmed next step.
assia_unknown_terminal.sla: Do not promise before checking ticket SLA

Code 67 appears on an existing TT: Data Ports

Another cause or unsure; search the code table

close_code_cable.question: Which code appears on the existing ticket?

close_code_8_terminal.finding: Closure reason: internal wiring was repaired.
close_code_8_terminal.action: Use code 8 only if the repair was completed and the option matches current TTS.
close_code_8_terminal.customer_script: The internal wiring has been repaired. May I confirm the service is stable with you?

close_code_81_terminal.question: Code 81 on an existing ticket: internal cable maintenance.
close_code_81_terminal.finding: The training table describes 81 as an internal cable issue requiring maintenance; this workflow handles a code already shown on an open ticket.

close_code_81_terminal.reference_guidance: References: day_8.pdf and SLA.pdf. Use the existing TT reference.

close_code_82_terminal.action: Check there is no Major Fault and complete the normal checks, then update/re-escalate the existing ticket. The day 8 guide says to skip the main-wire test in this path. Do not create a duplicate ticket.
close_code_82_terminal.customer_script: I will review the existing ticket and checks, continue on the same request with the relevant team, and give you its displayed timeframe.

close_code_82_terminal.reference_guidance: References: day_8.pdf and SLA.pdf. Use the existing TT reference.

close_code_unknown_terminal.sla: Do not promise before confirming the path

wifi_devices_terminal.question: Quick guide for weak Wi-Fi coverage and devices.
wifi_devices_terminal.finding: Weak in-home coverage may need router placement or an extender; it does not by itself mean the line is faulty.
wifi_devices_terminal.action: Test speed near the router and distinguish coverage from line speed. RE200 (AC750) supports up to 300 Mbps at 2.4 GHz. Deco M5 has four internal antennas and Self-Healing. Confirm compatibility and current availability/price. Return guidance: 14 days from delivery without cause, with exceptions, or 30 days for defective goods; apply the official terms and product condition.
wifi_devices_terminal.customer_script: If speed is good near the router but weak in a distant room, we can check a coverage option. I will confirm compatibility, current availability, price, and applicable return terms first.
wifi_devices_terminal.reference_guidance: Manufacturer specs: tp-link.com/us/home-networking/range-extender/re200/v3/ and tp-link.com/us/deco-mesh-wifi/product-family/deco-m5/. Returns: Egypt Consumer Protection Agency at cpa.gov.eg.
wifi_devices_terminal.sla: Immediate inquiry; price and availability depend on current system

enterprise_terminal.question: Quick guide for enterprise inquiries.
enterprise_terminal.finding: Covers short numbers, CNAM, and business services.
enterprise_terminal.action: Verify eligibility and current rules in the enterprise system. The day 14 training guide confirms short numbers have five digits, but does not establish current prefixes/prices. It lists a maximum 50-character English CNAM name. Use current product details/prices for Smart Parking, WE FinTech, and commercial BeIN.
enterprise_terminal.customer_script: I will check the service requirements for your business, current price and coverage, and explain activation and provide an order reference if created.
enterprise_terminal.reference_guidance: Training reference: day_14.pdf. Verify prefixes, prices, and service terms in the current enterprise system.
enterprise_terminal.sla: Depends on business service; verify current SLA

start_menu.question: Choose a path or search directly.

preflight_start.question: Before troubleshooting, have you checked TTS History for an open TT for this same fault?

options.label: No open TT for this fault; continue checks
An open TT exists; record its reference and update it, then continue
TT status is unclear; search by service number first

outage_precheck.question: Does the approved tool show an outage, planned outage, or major fault for this service or area?

options.label: An outage is possible or the tool result is unclear

billing_precheck.question: Is the account/service active with no unpaid balance or billing suspension?

options.label: There is an unpaid balance or billing suspension
The account is active with no blocking balance
Status is unclear; verify the account before troubleshooting

quota_precheck.question: Check package usage and validity in the support systems.

options.label: The package expired or allowance is exhausted
The package is active with allowance; start fault diagnosis

quota_precheck.check_guidance: In CST360, open the service and go to Offer Management > Top Applications & Consumption details; review the base package, usage/remaining allowance, and validity or renewal date. For a CST360 Redirect indication, check NST > Session Logs; for TDM, open Matrix > Get Online Service and check the Redirect status. Confirm the package and balance in BSS before classifying.
quota_precheck.action: If system data shows the package expired or no allowance remains, choose “The package expired or allowance is exhausted.” If it is active with allowance, choose “The package is active with allowance.” If CST360/Matrix/BSS does not show a confirmed result, choose “Usage could not be verified”; do not guess.
quota_precheck.source_reference: day 12.pdf p. 20 (Offer Management > Top Applications & Consumption details); day 11.pdf p. 4 (CST360/NST Session Logs or Matrix > Get Online Service for TDM); day 13.pdf (Check Quota and Exceed Quota flow).

technical_type.question: Choose the issue type confirmed after the pre-checks.

options.label: Complaint about a visit/staff interaction or supervisor request

existing_tt_terminal.question: Check fault tickets before creating a new one.
existing_tt_terminal.action: Search TTS History by service number. If an open TT exists for the same fault, record its reference and update it instead of creating a duplicate. Then return and check outage, account status, and package usage.
existing_tt_terminal.customer_script: I will first check the fault history for your line so I can follow the existing case and avoid creating a duplicate request.
existing_tt_terminal.reference_guidance: If updating an existing TT, tell the customer its TTS reference and displayed SLA. Do not create a duplicate. IR is internal; share it only if the system explicitly marks it as a customer-facing reference.
existing_tt_terminal.sla: Use the SLA recorded on the existing ticket

outage_unconfirmed_terminal.question: A general outage is possible, but it is not confirmed in the tool.
outage_unconfirmed_terminal.action: Check Customer360/Outage Tool. If the result remains unclear, ask the team leader to confirm before opening an individual fault ticket. If a Major Fault is confirmed, follow its process and record the announcement/reference. Attach a screenshot of the Major Fault message to its SR when that process requires it; screenshots are not a blanket requirement for every outage.
outage_unconfirmed_terminal.customer_script: I will verify the network status with the relevant team and share the official update time once the outage status is confirmed.
outage_unconfirmed_terminal.reference_guidance: If a Major Fault is confirmed and an SR/TT is opened, share only the customer-facing reference. Record the outage reference internally. Attach a screenshot when the Major Fault process requires it, not for every outage. Do not share internal IR numbers.
outage_unconfirmed_terminal.sla: Use the official system SLA after status is confirmed

billing_terminal.question: Account status may be preventing the service from working.
billing_terminal.action: Check the current balance and suspension status in the approved system. Quote only the current amount and available payment channel. Do not open a technical fault TT until the billing block is cleared; retest the service after the status updates.
billing_terminal.customer_script: I can see an outstanding balance or service suspension. I will explain the current amount and payment options, then we can retest the service after the account updates.
billing_terminal.sla: According to payment processing and system update

billing_verify_terminal.question: Billing or suspension status could not be confirmed.
billing_verify_terminal.action: Do not classify this as a technical fault until account/service status is confirmed in the approved system. Do not ask for payment credentials or passwords. Once verified, return to the package check and continue.
billing_verify_terminal.customer_script: I will verify the service and billing status first, then continue with the right steps for your case.

quota_terminal.question: The package has expired or its allowance is exhausted.
quota_terminal.action: Confirm allowance and validity in the system. Explain current renewal/add-on options and prices from the live source. Do not record this as a technical fault or create a TT for exhausted allowance.
quota_terminal.customer_script: I checked your package usage, and it has expired/reached its available limit. I can explain the renewal or add-on options currently available.
quota_terminal.sla: According to completion of renewal or add-on

quota_verify_terminal.question: Package usage could not be confirmed.
quota_verify_terminal.action: Check package usage and validity in the system before recording a fault. Do not rely on an estimate or an outdated package table. Continue with the relevant path once the status is visible.
quota_verify_terminal.customer_script: I will check your package usage and validity in the system, then we can decide whether to renew it or continue technical checks.
quota_verify_terminal.sla: Continue after usage information is available

physical_start.question: Identify the DSL/ADSL light status during the fault.
physical_start.customer_prompt: Please check the router and tell me whether the DSL/ADSL light is off, steady, or blinking.

options.label: Stable, but no IP, browsing, or speed is affected

physical_start.action: Classify from the DSL/ADSL light: off or blinking routes to Physical and power/wiring checks. A steady light routes to Logical even if the customer reports no internet; then check WAN IP. Do not record a cause or repair before a test confirms it.

power_check.question: Check the router power source and Power light status.
power_check.customer_prompt: When the service drops, is the Power light steady, off, or flickering?

options.label: No, it is off or unstable

power_check.action: Confirm the router is powered and the Power light is steady. If power is normal, continue to line-log checks; if it is off or unstable, follow the device checks without opening it.

dsl_status_unknown.question: Ask the customer to read the DSL/ADSL light on the router, or check a router photo if available.
dsl_status_unknown.action: Do not classify the issue as physical or logical until the light status is known. Use the router model guide if the light has a different name.
dsl_status_unknown.customer_script: Could you check the router and tell me whether the DSL or ADSL light is off, steady, or blinking?
dsl_status_unknown.sla: Continue troubleshooting after identifying the light status
dsl_status_unknown.customer_prompt: Could you check the router lights and tell me whether DSL/ADSL is steady, off, or blinking?

power_terminal.question: The router may have a power supply issue.
power_terminal.action: Check the original adapter and power source. Try another outlet, then another router with a compatible adapter if available. If the issue continues, follow the approved device inspection or follow-up process. Do not ask the customer to open the device.
power_terminal.customer_script: Let us check the router power light and adapter, then try another outlet. If the issue continues, we can arrange an inspection through the approved process.
power_terminal.reference_guidance: If you open a device-inspection follow-up, give the customer its visible reference and current timeframe. Create a technical TT only when that path applies; do not share an internal IR number.
power_terminal.sla: Immediate diagnosis; follow-up according to the ticket
power_terminal.customer_prompt: Let’s try the router in another power outlet and check that its original power adapter is connected. Please do not open the device.

data_down_logs.question: Using internal diagnostic tools only, without sharing their details with the customer, what do the last 12 hours of system logs show?

options.label: At least 3 logs, including one in the last 3 hours
That log rule does not apply; classify as Data Down

data_down_logs.customer_prompt: I am checking the line from our support tools. I do not need your router login. I will continue once I have the result.
data_down_logs.action: Check the last 12 hours of logs in internal support tools only. Three or more logs, including one in the last three hours, route to the instability path; otherwise continue Data Down classification and wiring checks. Do not expose internal log details to the customer.

wiring_check.question: Identify how the router is connected to the telephone line.
wiring_check.customer_prompt: Is the router connected directly to the main line, or through a wall socket/filter?

options.label: Main wire directly to the router
The customer cannot identify the wiring

main_wire_check.question: After direct connection, check whether the DSL light returned.
main_wire_check.customer_prompt: After connecting the router directly to the main line, is the DSL light steady now?

wall_wiring_check.question: Check the filter and internal wiring.
wall_wiring_check.customer_prompt: Can we check that the filter and wires are connected properly? Have we tried bypassing the filter?

options.label: We corrected the wiring and service returned
We bypassed the splitter, but the issue remains
Wiring is correct, but the line is still down

instability_visit.question: Check whether a technician visit or wiring change preceded the instability.
instability_visit.customer_prompt: Was there a technician visit or any wiring change before the issue started?

options.label: Yes, there was a visit or change
The line recovered during the call

after_visit_check.question: Check the result of the visit/change and whether the fault remains.
after_visit_check.customer_prompt: After the visit or wiring change, is the service stable now or does the issue remain?

options.label: No, service is stable after the check

stable_after_recheck.question: Did ASSIA/Clear View confirm that there is no physical-layer issue?

options.label: Yes, no physical issue and the line is stable
No, or the result is unavailable

physical_escalation.question: Before closing the physical-fault path, confirm: is this a Physical Instability complaint routed to IU?
physical_escalation.action: For a standard Physical Instability case routed to IU, run ASSIA Clear View with Last fix within 24 hours, check Major Fault/Outage and Hayah Karima status, then update the existing TT or create the correct complaint. The Case Escalation (SLA) table lists 24 hours to resolve IU Physical Instability; confirm the actual case SLA and any special SLA in the system. Give the customer the TT/complaint reference and displayed SLA. Two hours is not the repair SLA for this IU complaint; it is the NOC follow-up call after resolution on the NOC path only. Do not apply NOC/On Call handling to an IU complaint unless the system directs it.
physical_escalation.customer_script: I logged the physical fault under reference (read the TT/complaint number). The SLA recorded for your case is (read the actual system SLA; the standard IU reference is 24 hours unless a special SLA or exception applies). We will follow up using the same complaint reference.
physical_escalation.reference_guidance: Give the customer their TT/complaint reference and displayed SLA. Share an SR number only if it was created and is approved as a customer-facing reference. Record IR internally and do not share it unless it is explicitly customer-facing. The 2-hour timing applies to NOC follow-up after resolution, not IU Physical Instability repair.
physical_escalation.sla: IU Physical Instability: 24 hours to resolve per the Case Escalation (SLA) table; verify the TT and any special SLA/Outage/Hayah Karima before quoting.

options.label: Yes, Physical Instability complaint routed to IU
No, the system routes this case to NOC / On Call

physical_escalation.customer_prompt: I will finish checking the line and wiring and record the appropriate follow-up. If a ticket is created, I will give you its reference and the displayed timeframe.

logical_start.question: Choose the actual logical symptom after excluding outage, account, and quota.
logical_start.customer_prompt: Is the internet down, are only some websites unavailable, is the speed slow, or does the connection drop?

options.label: Drops while DSL stays steady; Logical Instability
General slowness or speed below profile
Poor line quality/low speed; check BLQ
WAN IP, browsing, or inconsistent readings

logical_start.action: Complete initial checks before technical steps. Select the specific case; do not equate slowness with BLQ or skip Physical checks before Gaming.

no_ip_check.question: Using the approved support tool, and without asking for the customer's password, have you checked MAC status, CPE settings, and connection details?

options.label: MAC is not learned or settings are incorrect
Settings look correct, but there is still no IP

no_ip_check.customer_prompt: I will check the router’s internet connection in our system. Please do not share your router password; if a setting needs adjustment, I will guide you through it.
no_ip_check.action: Check MAC, WAN IP, and connection data in the approved tool. If settings are wrong, guide the customer through the approved CPE setup without requesting a password; if settings are correct and there is no IP, escalate with readings and tests.

cpe_reconfigure.question: After CPE setup, check whether the router received an IP and service returned.
cpe_reconfigure.customer_prompt: After configuring the router, is the Internet light on and is the service back?

options.label: No, there is still no IP

browsing_check.question: Identify the scope of the browsing issue: all devices or a specific device/site.
browsing_check.customer_prompt: Does browsing fail on all devices, or only on one device or website?

options.label: All sites or more than one device

browsing_network_steps.question: After network checks and another device/router test, confirm whether the fault remains.
browsing_network_steps.customer_prompt: After trying another device/router, is the issue still happening?

options.label: Yes, attach a site trace according to the process

browsing_device_steps.question: Test browsing on another device or browser.
browsing_device_steps.customer_prompt: Does browsing work if we try another device or browser?

options.label: Yes, the issue is limited to one device/browser
No, it affects more than one device

slowness_check.question: After checking the package allowance and expected line speed, is the current speed below the recorded value?

options.label: No, it is within range or in the optimization period
Yes, it is below range or optimization has ended

slowness_check.action: Check package usage/validity and the line speed recorded in the system. Ask for the approved speed test, then compare it with the line profile and any optimization period before choosing a path.
slowness_check.customer_prompt: Could you run the usual speed test with the router connected directly? I will compare the result with the speed recorded for your line.

speed_within_range.question: The speed is within the expected range or the line is still in its optimization period.
speed_within_range.action: Compare the measured speed with the line and package details in the system. Explain that DSL speed can be affected by line distance, network load, and shared capacity. Do not rely on old package prices or speed tables from training PDFs.
speed_within_range.customer_script: I have checked the expected speed for your line. The service is within the current range/optimization period, and we can review it again when that period ends.
speed_within_range.sla: According to the optimization period recorded for the line
speed_within_range.customer_prompt: I will compare the line speed shown in our system with your speed-test result, then explain whether it is within the expected range.

slowness_troubleshoot.question: Run the approved speed test and confirm whether slowness continues.
slowness_troubleshoot.customer_prompt: After a direct speed test on one device, is the speed still slow?

logical_logs.question: Are there repeated system logs or fault indicators, and has another CPE been tested?

options.label: Yes, logs exist or the issue continues with another CPE
No logs; test another CPE and check for an Outage

logical_logs.customer_prompt: I will review the connection logs in our support tools, then ask you to try another router only if the check requires it.
logical_logs.action: Review connection indicators in internal tools and confirm whether another CPE was tested. Do not ask the customer for a password. Record the findings before escalation or re-testing.

logical_recheck.question: After checking Outage and testing another CPE, identify whether the issue remains.
logical_recheck.customer_prompt: After trying another router and checking network status, does the issue remain?

noc_escalation.question: Before escalating to NOC: is the expected follow-up period between 10 PM and 8 AM?
noc_escalation.action: Record the symptoms, start time, tested devices, and troubleshooting results. Update the existing TT or create the correct one, and record its number and displayed SLA. If follow-up is expected between 10 PM and 8 AM, ask whether the customer is available for a call. If yes, create/update IR as required, select Case Type: On Call (To SLS), and record all troubleshooting steps. The NOC follow-up call is expected within two hours after the issue is resolved; this is a post-resolution follow-up, not a promise to fix the issue within two hours. If the customer is unavailable, say the team will follow up after 8 AM. Do not share internal IR numbers.
noc_escalation.customer_script: Your complaint/TT reference is (read the system number), and the recorded case SLA is (read it as shown). For NOC follow-up, the team will call within two hours after the issue is resolved. (If you are unavailable overnight: the team will follow up after 8 AM.)
noc_escalation.reference_guidance: Give the customer the customer-facing TT/complaint reference and actual case SLA. Share an SR number only if it was created with a customer-facing reference. IR is internal. Keep the case-resolution SLA separate from the NOC call within two hours after resolution.
noc_escalation.sla: NOC follow-up call: within two hours after resolution when applicable; case-resolution SLA depends on the case and the TT.

options.label: Yes, follow-up is between 10 PM and 8 AM
No, follow-up is outside the night window

noc_escalation.customer_prompt: I will record the checks and send the case to the responsible team. Are you available for a call if the team needs to follow up overnight?

speed_variance_terminal.question: The speed values differ between system tools.
speed_variance_terminal.action: Check the package speed, profile, and operational speed in approved tools. Resolve the Speed Variance path before continuing other logical-fault checks. Record the readings and escalate to the responsible team using the SLA shown in the system.
speed_variance_terminal.customer_script: I found a mismatch in the speed information on our systems. I will send it for technical review before continuing other checks.
speed_variance_terminal.reference_guidance: After logging/escalating Speed Variance, give the customer the customer-facing TT/complaint reference and displayed SLA. Do not share an internal IR number.
speed_variance_terminal.sla: According to the Speed Variance path shown in the system
speed_variance_terminal.customer_prompt: I will compare the speed readings in our system and explain the result once I reconcile them.

outage_terminal.question: The issue may be related to a general network outage.
outage_terminal.action: Confirm the outage, type, and end time in Outage Tool or Customer360, and record its announcement/reference. Do not open a duplicate individual TT during a confirmed general outage. Give the official SLA shown. If the outage is unclear, ask the team leader to confirm. If the outage window ends and the issue remains, resume individual diagnosis and update/create the correct TT. Create an SR and attach a screenshot only when the Major Fault/current process requires it; this is not a blanket requirement for every outage.
outage_terminal.customer_script: I checked the network status, and the issue is related to a general outage (record the outage reference from the system). The official SLA and update time are the ones shown in our system. If the issue continues after the outage ends, we will continue checking your line and follow up using the recorded reference.
outage_terminal.reference_guidance: Share the outage reference only if it is approved for customers. Do not create an individual TT for a confirmed general outage. If the process creates a customer-facing SR/TT, read its actual reference; do not share an internal IR number.
outage_terminal.sla: According to the official Outage notice; do not estimate a resolution time

voice_start.question: Identify whether only landline voice or both voice and internet are affected.
voice_start.customer_prompt: Is only the landline dial tone affected, or are both landline and internet affected?

voice_down_terminal.question: A landline voice case has been identified.
voice_down_terminal.action: Complete the required customer verification. Record whether this is Voice Down or Voice Overlapping, check visit/wiring history and Outages, then create or update the IU/specialist-team ticket according to the process. Record the customer's confirmation.
voice_down_terminal.customer_script: I have recorded the landline issue and the verification results. I will send it to the specialist team for follow-up and contact you according to the case SLA.
voice_down_terminal.reference_guidance: After creating/updating the voice TT, give the customer its reference and SLA. If the process creates an SR with a customer-facing reference, share it too. Do not share internal IR numbers.
voice_down_terminal.sla: 24 hours for the listed IU cases; verify the actual case SLA

request_start.question: Which installation request or follow-up is this?

options.label: Check availability or place a new line request
Follow up on an existing installation

availability_check.question: Which technology is required or available at the address?

copper_install_terminal.question: An MSAN/TDM line request was identified.
copper_install_terminal.action: Check address and availability in the approved tool, then submit through the correct channel. Quote the reference installation time only after confirming line type and order status.
copper_install_terminal.customer_script: Once availability is confirmed and the request is submitted, the reference installation time for an MSAN/TDM line is up to 5 working days.
copper_install_terminal.reference_guidance: After submitting the installation request, give the customer the order reference generated by the system. Do not claim it was submitted or invent a number before it appears.
copper_install_terminal.sla: 5 working days after the request is completed, subject to availability

fiber_install_terminal.question: An FTTH request was identified.
fiber_install_terminal.action: For a new order, open Check Availability in CST360/Matrix, search the correct address, and confirm Available + Valid before quoting speed or creating an order. After completing the contract, submit FTTH New Subscriber Order in OM as the current procedure requires. For an existing FTTH Migration, check the order number and Current Activity in BS and OM. Never assume installation is free; confirm the fee and due date for this address in the system.
fiber_install_terminal.customer_script: I will first check FTTH coverage at your address and confirm Available/Valid. If it is available, I will explain the fee and timeframe shown for your address, submit the order, and give you its reference. Training references list 7 days for Cairo, Giza, and Alexandria and 10 days for other governorates; I will confirm the current timeframe before promising it.
fiber_install_terminal.reference_guidance: After an FTTH request is accepted/submitted, give the customer its actual system reference. Do not invent a number or date.
fiber_install_terminal.sla: 7 days in Cairo/Giza/Alexandria; 10 days in other governorates

availability_terminal.question: Availability must be confirmed before giving the customer a commitment.
availability_terminal.action: Open Check Availability in CST360/Matrix for the line type. Search with the required service number/address, record whether the result is Available and Valid, and note the displayed technology and recommended speed. Attach a screenshot if the procedure asks for one. If the result is unclear, follow the system's availability SR/check path rather than guessing coverage or fees.
availability_terminal.customer_script: I will check coverage for your address in the system. If Available and Valid appears, I will explain the available technology, speed, fee, and timeframe before submitting any order. If it is unavailable or unclear, I will explain the reason and the next step shown in the system.
availability_terminal.reference_guidance: If you submit an availability SR, give the customer its actual SR reference when one is generated. Do not invent a number.
availability_terminal.sla: Depends on the request type and channel; check the system SLA

order_followup.question: Check whether an installation order or ticket reference exists.
order_followup.customer_prompt: Do you have the installation order or follow-up reference number?

options.label: Yes, check the current order status and activity
No, search for orders on the account

order_status_check.question: How does the order status compare with the SLA shown in the system?

options.label: Within SLA, with no visible error
SLA exceeded or status is Failed/Abnormal
Order is complete but service is not working

order_within_sla.question: The order is still within its SLA.
order_within_sla.action: Tell the customer the current status and activity shown in the system. Do not create a duplicate request. Record the inquiry and check again if a new error appears.
order_within_sla.customer_script: I checked your order, and it is still within the expected timeframe. Its current status is [status from the system], and we will follow any new update.
order_within_sla.reference_guidance: Use the existing installation order number and status from the system, and tell the customer its reference and remaining displayed timeframe. Do not create a second order.
order_within_sla.sla: Remaining time shown in the system

installation_delay.question: The installation order is delayed or has an error.
installation_delay.action: Review Order Query, the sub-activity, and the failure reason. Check whether a Delay TT was created automatically; do not duplicate it. If the SLA has expired or an error is present, create the required follow-up/escalation for the responsible team and include the order number, status, and notes.
installation_delay.customer_script: I found a delay/error in the order activity and recorded it for the responsible team. I will update you according to the timeframe shown in the system.
installation_delay.reference_guidance: Use the order/TT reference created or updated by the system and tell the customer the reference and SLA. Share an automatic Delay TT only if it is marked customer-facing; IR is internal.
installation_delay.sla: Depends on the order type and activity; use the timeframe shown in the system

options.label: Home internet package inquiry (WE Space / OneHome)
Activate or cancel an add-on service/package

package_inquiry_terminal.question: WE Space home internet packages only.
package_inquiry_terminal.action: Check the line speed and WE Space eligibility in BSS, then explain the plan period, quota, and listed price. The published catalog has no separate payment-type selector; confirm eligibility, final price, and tax in the system. If the customer means internet bundled with fixed voice, go back and choose OneHome. Do not record an inquiry as an order without consent.
package_inquiry_terminal.customer_script: I will check line speed and WE Space eligibility, then explain the quota, price, and term. I will confirm the final price and tax in the system before submitting any order.
package_inquiry_terminal.sla: Immediate inquiry; fulfillment depends on the service

package_catalog.title: WE Space home internet package tables

addon_rows.term: One time or auto-renew every 30 days
One time or auto-renew every 30 days
One time or auto-renew every 30 days

notes: Prices shown on WE’s official page when reviewed; prices and availability can change. Match the line speed and customer eligibility, and confirm the final charge/tax in the internal system before quoting.
The page does not state tax treatment next to the monthly-plan table. It explicitly says add-on and yearly prices exclude VAT.
After the basic quota is consumed, browsing continues at a reduced speed; early renewal is available under the page terms.
staff_checks: For the currently subscribed plan, the day_11.pdf training reference says to check tool 855; confirm the tool and procedure are still current.
For speed questions, compare Contracted Speed in Matrix for TOM lines or CST 360 for other line types, as described in training; do not reuse an old PDF SLA.
Check package usage. The official page says browsing continues at reduced speed after the basic quota is consumed, so verify usage before classifying slow speed as a fault.
Before offering or submitting a change, verify technology/availability, line eligibility, final price, and tax in the current system.
If the customer means a mobile or WE Air plan, do not use this table; open the matching service catalog in the current system.
package_catalog.scope_note: This table is for WE Space home internet only; do not use it for mobile or WE Air plans. Verify the technology and speed availability on the line.

package_inquiry_terminal.reference_guidance: For an existing-plan inquiry, use the current account view in BSS; do not rely on a training slide to identify a tool. Do not record an inquiry as an order or fault.

device_inquiry_terminal.question: Technical inquiry about a CPE or one of its lights.
device_inquiry_terminal.action: Identify the device model and service type, then use the approved device guide to explain the light or setting. Do not ask for the router admin password or change unrelated settings.
device_inquiry_terminal.customer_script: I will identify the router model and the light you see, then explain its meaning and the appropriate step from the device guide.

service_request_terminal.question: Request to activate or cancel an add-on service.
service_request_terminal.action: Complete the required verification and confirm the service name, customer request, and eligibility. Check current fees and SLA before activation/cancellation, then record the request and result.
service_request_terminal.customer_script: I will confirm the requested service, eligibility, and current fees before submitting it. I will then provide a reference number if one is generated.
service_request_terminal.reference_guidance: After submitting the service request, give the customer the SR/order reference generated by the system. If no reference is generated, explain that it was recorded without inventing a number.
service_request_terminal.sla: Depends on the service and channel; check the system

billing_inquiry_start.question: Identify whether this is a bill inquiry, an unposted payment, or a payment made to another number by mistake.
billing_inquiry_start.customer_prompt: Is this about a bill, a payment that has not appeared, or a payment made to another WE number by mistake?

options.label: Service stopped due to a small balance (Balance Fraction)
Temporary restoration / Promise to Pay inquiry
Payment was made to another number by mistake

wrong_number_payment_check.question: Check the transaction/receipt, then establish whether the customer agrees to a Balance Transfer.
wrong_number_payment_check.customer_prompt: Would you agree to have us check a transfer to the correct number, or would you like us to check refund eligibility?

options.label: Customer does not agree or requests a refund

wrong_number_transfer_terminal.question: Payment was sent to another number, and the customer agrees to a Balance Transfer.
wrong_number_transfer_terminal.action: Match the receipt and transaction reference, the number paid, the intended number, and the customer's consent. Select the current TTS category for Balance Transfer / Paid on wrong number. The training SLA table lists TT: 3 hours if the customer agrees; verify the current category and SLA before logging. Never request the full card number or OTP.
wrong_number_transfer_terminal.customer_script: After I verify the transaction details and your agreement, I will record the request to transfer the amount to the correct number and give you the reference and timeframe shown in our system.
wrong_number_transfer_terminal.reference_guidance: After creating/updating a TT, give the customer its actual reference and current SLA. Do not share an internal IR number. Use the Clear Description below only after confirming the current TTS category.
wrong_number_transfer_terminal.clear_description: Paid on another number by mistake - Level 3 Billing
wrong_number_transfer_terminal.sla: Training table lists TT within 3 hours if customer agrees; verify current TTS SLA

wrong_number_refund_terminal.question: The customer does not agree to Balance Transfer or requests a refund.
wrong_number_refund_terminal.action: Check the current procedure for refund eligibility and channel. Do not record Balance Transfer as approved by the customer and do not promise an unconfirmed amount/timeframe. The training SLA table lists Refund via Branch: 5 working days; use only after confirming the channel and current SLA apply.
wrong_number_refund_terminal.customer_script: I will check the refund eligibility, correct channel, and approved timeframe for this transaction. After confirming, I will record the appropriate request and give you its reference if one is issued.
wrong_number_refund_terminal.reference_guidance: If a refund request/complaint is logged, give the customer the SR/complaint reference generated by the system and current timeframe. Do not share internal IR numbers or use Balance Transfer without customer consent.
wrong_number_refund_terminal.sla: Check the current refund type/channel; training reference lists 5 working days for Refund via Branch

payment_not_clear_terminal.question: The payment has not appeared or is unclear.
payment_not_clear_terminal.action: Check the payment channel, transaction reference, and time. Distinguish a bill payment from a transfer to the company account. Review the receipt and system transaction. Never ask for the full card number or verification code. Select the complaint type for the payment channel and check its SLA.
payment_not_clear_terminal.customer_script: I will check the payment channel, reference, and time, then record the correct follow-up after verifying the receipt. Please do not send your card details or verification code.
payment_not_clear_terminal.reference_guidance: After logging the payment complaint, tell the customer the complaint/reference number shown in the system and its SLA. Do not share an internal IR number.
payment_not_clear_terminal.sla: Depends on the payment channel; check the system timeframe

billing_inquiry_terminal.question: Bill, balance, or usage inquiry.
billing_inquiry_terminal.action: Complete customer verification before disclosing information. Review the bill, usage, and payment record in the system. For a payment complaint, verify the channel and transaction reference, then select the correct complaint type.
billing_inquiry_terminal.customer_script: After verifying the account, I will review the bill/balance details and explain the items or next step.
billing_inquiry_terminal.reference_guidance: If this becomes a payment complaint and you log it, give the customer its complaint reference and displayed SLA. A bill inquiry alone does not require a ticket number.
billing_inquiry_terminal.sla: Immediate inquiry; complaints depend on the transaction type

account_change_terminal.question: Request to change or cancel a service/number.
account_change_terminal.action: For a fixed-internet plan or payment-type change: after full verification, open BSS Tool > Change Offering (Fixed) and select Prepaid/Postpaid or the requested plan. Check debt, fees, eligibility, renewal date, and any open Processing Order. Do not proceed before customer consent; create the Service Request in BSS as the current workflow shows, track it, and do not duplicate it. For a service cancellation or number change, use that service's specific system path; do not apply Change Offering to an unrelated request.
account_change_terminal.customer_script: I will check your account type, requested plan or service, any fee, and when the change takes effect in the system. I will explain the details before submitting the request, then give you its generated reference and displayed timeframe.
account_change_terminal.reference_guidance: After completing a service change/cancellation, give the customer the SR/order reference generated by the system. Do not make the change before consent or invent a number.
account_change_terminal.sla: Depends on the request type; check the current SLA

complaint_start.question: Classify the complaint before choosing its path.
complaint_start.customer_prompt: Is the complaint about a technical issue, a technician/staff interaction, or a request to speak with a supervisor?

options.label: Customer is dissatisfied and requests a supervisor

technical_complaint_terminal.question: Technical complaint.
technical_complaint_terminal.action: Record the customer's description, time, completed checks, and results. Link the complaint to an existing technical ticket if available. Select the escalation team and SLA for the issue. Do not promise a timeframe that is not shown in the system.
technical_complaint_terminal.customer_script: I am sorry about the issue. I have recorded the details and checks completed, and I will follow it with the specialist team according to the stated timeframe.
technical_complaint_terminal.reference_guidance: Link the complaint to the existing TT or new complaint reference, then give the customer the follow-up reference and displayed timeframe. Do not share internal IR numbers.
technical_complaint_terminal.sla: Depends on the complaint type and assigned team

conduct_complaint_terminal.question: Complaint about a technician visit or staff conduct.
conduct_complaint_terminal.action: Record the time, location, visit details, reason for the complaint, and only the contact details needed. Create the complaint for the responsible team. Do not add unnecessary personal information.
conduct_complaint_terminal.customer_script: I have recorded the necessary details of your complaint and will send it to the responsible team for review and follow-up according to its SLA.
conduct_complaint_terminal.reference_guidance: After logging the complaint, give the customer its reference and SLA if the system generated them. Do not guess or share an internal reference.
conduct_complaint_terminal.sla: Check the complaint team's SLA in the system

escalation_request_terminal.question: The customer requests contact with a supervisor.
escalation_request_terminal.action: Offer a callback or immediate supervisor path according to current policy. Record the reason for dissatisfaction and confirm only the timeframe permitted by the procedure.
escalation_request_terminal.customer_script: I will record your request to speak with a supervisor and explain the approved follow-up method and timeframe before we end the call.
escalation_request_terminal.reference_guidance: If a complaint/callback request was logged with a reference, give the customer the approved follow-up number and timeframe. Do not promise a number or SLA that is not shown.
escalation_request_terminal.sla: According to the escalation path in the system

device_terminal.question: The issue is limited to one device or browser.
device_terminal.action: Guide the customer to check the affected device or browser and retest on another device. Do not change general network settings when other devices work.
device_terminal.customer_script: Because the service works on another device, the issue appears limited to this device or browser. Let us check its settings or try another browser.

resolved_terminal.question: The customer confirmed that service returned after troubleshooting.
resolved_terminal.action: Retest the service and record the resolution and customer confirmation. Open the close-code table below and match its description to the actual TTS reason before closing. If none match, do not guess; ask the responsible lead.
resolved_terminal.customer_script: Great. Is the service working normally now? I have recorded the step that fixed the issue. Thank you for confirming.
resolved_terminal.customer_prompt: After the steps we tried, is the internet back and working normally on your device?

exceptions_start.question: Did TTS History show one of these special cases or close-code updates? Check open and closed history before troubleshooting.

options.label: Close Code 74: CPE problem in the last 30 days
Close Code 24: landline out of service
Outside TEData: FCC in another department on the same line
Major Fault: voice returned but internet remains affected
Close Code 28: customer refused a visit
Physical Instability Contradiction: customer reports drops but ASSIA shows no physical layer

exception_74.question: Is the customer in Cairo/Alexandria or another governorate?

options.label: Cairo or Alexandria: router inspection at branch
Another governorate: test an alternate router

exception_74_cairo.question: Check the result of the router inspection at the branch.
exception_74_cairo.customer_prompt: After the router was inspected at the branch, is the issue still happening?

options.label: Yes, inspection and history criteria are met
No, inspection or another criterion is missing

exception_74_other.question: Check the result of the alternate-router test.
exception_74_other.customer_prompt: After trying another router, is the issue still happening?

options.label: Yes, test and history criteria are met
No, test or another criterion is missing

exception_74_branch.question: The Code 74 CPE path for Cairo/Alexandria requires branch router inspection.
exception_74_branch.action: Ask the customer to visit a branch for router inspection. The training guide does not replace this with an alternate-router test for Cairo/Alexandria. Return to this flow after documenting inspection.
exception_74_branch.customer_script: We need the router inspected at a branch first. If the issue remains after inspection, we will continue with the appropriate escalation steps.
exception_74_branch.sla: Do not escalate this path before branch inspection is documented

exception_74_test.question: The Code 74 path in other governorates requires an alternate CPE test.
exception_74_test.action: Ask the customer to test another router through the approved process and document the result. Never ask for the router password. If the issue remains, check TTS history for BLQ, Physical Instability, or Data Down.
exception_74_test.customer_script: Let us test another suitable router and record the result; then I can choose the correct technical action.
exception_74_test.sla: Do not escalate this path before the test is documented

exception_74_escalate.question: The issue remains after CPE inspection, and a qualifying TTS case is present.
exception_74_escalate.action: The training guide says to close the current TTS complaint and create a new TT with Technical Visit category; it lists a 24-hour SLA and phone contact. If delayed, create/update IR and renew one day as instructed. Verify current category and SLA in the live system before acting.
exception_74_escalate.customer_script: I have documented the router inspection and continuing issue. I will follow up with the specialist team by phone according to the SLA shown in the system.
exception_74_escalate.reference_guidance: After creating the new TT as required, give the customer its reference and current SLA. Any delay IR is internal; share it only if a separate customer-facing reference is provided.
exception_74_escalate.sla: 24 hours in the case guide; confirm in the system

exception_8182.question: Is Close Code 81/82 in TTS history, and have you checked that there is no Major Fault?

options.label: Yes, code is present and no Major Fault exists
Major Fault exists or has not been checked

exception_8182_action.question: Close Code 81/82: internal or external cable maintenance.
exception_8182_action.action: Run the normal physical checks and verify Major Fault first. The guide says to assume direct connection and skip asking for another main-wire test. Then re-escalate the existing ticket and record the actual TTS code/result.
exception_8182_action.customer_script: I reviewed the fault history and checks, and will follow up on the existing case with the responsible team.
exception_8182_action.reference_guidance: Re-escalate the existing ticket and give the customer its TT reference and SLA. Do not create a duplicate when the path requires re-escalating the same ticket; IR is internal.
exception_8182_action.sla: Check the current SLA in TTS

exception_67.question: Is Close Code 67 shown on a previous ticket, and have you checked for a general outage?

options.label: Yes, code exists and no outage is present
Code is absent or outage has not been checked

exception_67_action.question: The guide associates Close Code 67 with a Data Ports problem.
exception_67_action.action: Check for a general outage, complete normal checks, and re-escalate the ticket to the responsible team. For Hayah Karima/repeated CPE, confirm the current path applies. Do not duplicate a ticket or use this code as proof the fault is fixed.
exception_67_action.customer_script: I will check the general network status and test results, then follow up on the ticket with the responsible team.
exception_67_action.reference_guidance: Re-escalate the existing TT without duplicating it, and give the customer its reference and displayed SLA. Do not share internal IR numbers.

exception_27.question: Is there an FTTH Migration Order linked to the Address Modification / Close Code 27 update?

options.label: Yes, an FTTH migration order exists

exception_27_migration.question: An FTTH Migration Order exists.
exception_27_migration.action: Follow the current order stage and the approved FTTH Migration script in the Wiki. Search by service/order number, record the stage, and do not open a duplicate request.
exception_27_migration.customer_script: I will check the stage of your fiber migration order and explain its current update and next step.
exception_27_migration.reference_guidance: Follow the existing FTTH Migration Order and give the customer its visible order reference; do not create a second request.
exception_27_migration.sla: According to the current order stage and system SLA

exception_27_branch.question: No FTTH Migration Order is linked to the address change.
exception_27_branch.action: The training guide directs the customer to the branch accounts department with the documents required for address modification. Verify current document requirements and branch hours first; training hours may be outdated.
exception_27_branch.customer_script: I do not see a linked fiber migration order. I will verify the current documents and branch instructions for you.

exception_24.question: Check whether the landline has dial tone.
exception_24.customer_prompt: When you pick up the landline handset, do you hear a dial tone or silence?

exception_24_on.question: The line is shown Out of Service, but dial tone works.
exception_24_on.action: Compare the system line status with the dial-tone test, then continue normal line/voice checks. Do not rely only on the Out of Service label when dial tone works.
exception_24_on.customer_script: I will compare the system line status with the dial-tone test and continue based on the result.
exception_24_on.sla: According to the actual line status in the system

exception_24_off.question: The line is shown Out of Service and has no dial tone.
exception_24_off.action: Check invoices and service cancellation status. If there are outstanding invoices, explain approved payment steps. Otherwise follow Pending Fixing as shown in the system; the training file says 3 days and customer-initiated phone follow-up, but confirm the current SLA first.
exception_24_off.customer_script: I will check the invoice and line status first, then explain the action and timeframe shown in the system.
exception_24_off.reference_guidance: If the system records Pending Fixing/TT, give the customer its customer-facing reference and current SLA. Do not share an internal IR number.
exception_24_off.sla: Check current Pending Fixing; training guide says 3 days

exception_outside.question: Is another FCC on the same line assigned to a different department, such as landline service?

options.label: Yes, an Outside TEData update is present

exception_outside_action.question: Outside TEData update: a ticket exists in another department on the same line.
exception_outside_action.action: Do not withdraw or duplicate the ticket. Give the normal SLA shown on it. For a delay, check ADF: renew SLA if the complaint is open; if closed, troubleshoot again. Contact by phone only; create only one SR with category FBB Tech Problem > System issue > Outside TEData alongside the other steps.
exception_outside_action.customer_script: I found a related case in another department on the same line. I will follow its ticket and SLA, then contact you by phone as specified.
exception_outside_action.reference_guidance: Give the customer the existing other-department ticket reference and SLA. If you create the SR required by Outside TEData, share its customer-facing reference; do not duplicate it or share an internal IR.
exception_outside_action.sla: According to the ticket and ADF; verify in system

exception_major_check.question: Is a Major Fault confirmed by Outage/ADF or a maintenance-team update?

options.label: No, it is not confirmed or is absent

exception_major.question: Check whether dial tone returned while internet remains affected.
exception_major.customer_prompt: Has the landline dial tone returned while the internet is still down?

options.label: Yes, voice is back and internet remains affected

exception_major_action.question: A Major Fault is still active or affecting both voice and internet.
exception_major_action.action: Verify Outage Tool/CST360 and ADF or a maintenance-team update; do not classify a Major Fault from symptoms alone. Give the official timeframe shown and review history before creating another ticket.
exception_major_action.customer_script: A major/general fault update is recorded. I will follow the official timeframe and update you with confirmed information.
exception_major_action.reference_guidance: If a TT/SR is created or updated under the Major Fault process, give the customer its follow-up reference and official SLA. Attach a Major Fault message screenshot to the SR when that path requires it; IR is internal.
exception_major_action.sla: According to the recorded Major Fault/Outage

exception_no_major.question: No Major Fault was confirmed.
exception_no_major.action: Continue the normal troubleshooting path and record where the check was made. Skip the direct-main-wire check only when Close Code 81/82 actually applies.
exception_no_major.customer_script: I could not confirm a Major Fault, so I will continue with the normal troubleshooting steps.

exception_major_data.question: Voice has returned, but internet remains affected after a Major Fault.
exception_major_data.action: Repeat the Data Down steps only after voice returns. Escalate the remaining internet issue through the current Data Down path; do not repeat voice checks that are resolved.
exception_major_data.customer_script: Since the landline is working again, I will focus on checking the internet and follow the next appropriate step.
exception_major_data.reference_guidance: After completing the path, give the customer the required TT/SR reference that is customer-facing and the displayed SLA. Do not share an internal IR number.
exception_major_data.sla: According to the current Data Down path

exception_28.question: Confirm whether the customer actually refused access/visit.
exception_28.customer_prompt: Did you refuse technician access, or was the visit unable to be completed?

options.label: Yes, the customer refused the visit/access
No, the customer did not refuse or another failure occurred

exception_28_action.question: Close Code 28 means customer refused the visit/access.
exception_28_action.action: Record the refusal and visit attempt time/result. Use code 28 only when refusal was the actual reason, follow rescheduling steps, and do not mark the issue as fixed.
exception_28_action.customer_script: I have recorded that the visit could not be completed because access was refused. I will explain the approved way to arrange another appointment.
exception_28_action.sla: According to the system rescheduling process

exception_contradiction.question: Record when the line drops and the DSL light status reported by the customer.
exception_contradiction.customer_prompt: Please tell me when the line drops and whether the DSL light turns off at that time.

options.label: Yes, customer report conflicts with ASSIA

exception_contradiction_hdm.question: Have you checked HDM DSL Physical Uptime and System Uptime, plus Clear View history and Fix Mode?

options.label: Yes, HDM/ASSIA indicates stability despite the report
No, tool is unavailable or result shows Physical/Dispatch

exception_contradiction_cpe.question: Check the full-day alternate-router test result from the main line.
exception_contradiction_cpe.customer_prompt: After testing another router from the main line for a full day, does the connection still drop?

options.label: Yes, test completed and issue remains
No, test was not completed or no alternate router is available

exception_contradiction_test.question: The full-day alternate-router test from the main line is incomplete.
exception_contradiction_test.action: Ask the customer to test an alternate router for one full day from the main line. If unavailable, direct the customer to an approved technical support branch for router inspection. Record the result before returning to this path.
exception_contradiction_test.customer_script: To identify the instability, we need to test another router from the main line for a full day. If one is unavailable, we can arrange an inspection through the approved branch process.
exception_contradiction_test.sla: Complete validation before opening a contradiction complaint

exception_contradiction_tools.question: ASSIA/HDM is inconclusive or indicates Physical Layer/Technician Dispatch.
exception_contradiction_tools.action: Review Clear View history, collection date, and Fix Mode, then check HDM, Line Details/Faults, and NST Logs as described in the guide. If the result is Technician Dispatch or Physical Layer, follow normal Physical Instability steps. Do not use the Contradiction path before validating tool results.
exception_contradiction_tools.customer_script: I will review the line measurements and test history first, then choose whether to continue the instability path or another check.
exception_contradiction_tools.sla: According to the tool result and current path

exception_contradiction_escalate.question: The customer report still conflicts with validated tools after the documented test.
exception_contradiction_escalate.action: Create a Physical Instability Contradiction complaint after Voice Verification. Select the system category that matches the actual result. Record HDM/ASSIA results and router test duration. Check Hayah Karima handling and current complaint requirements. The guide lists a 24-hour SLA; renew the SLA and create a Delay Ticket on IR/Case if delayed, following the current system process.
exception_contradiction_escalate.customer_script: After reviewing the line results and router test, I have recorded the case for technical review. We will follow up according to the SLA shown in the system.
exception_contradiction_escalate.reference_guidance: After logging the Physical Instability Contradiction complaint, give the customer its customer-facing reference and current SLA. IR/Delay records are internal; share them only if the system provides a customer-facing reference.
exception_contradiction_escalate.sla: 24 hours in the training guide; verify the current SLA

voice_verification.question: Verify the voice service: is there a dial tone on the landline?
voice_verification.customer_prompt: Reconnect the phone to the line socket and lift the handset. Do you hear a dial tone?

options.label: No dial tone or voice is affected

voice_verify_unknown.question: Voice service status could not be confirmed.
voice_verify_unknown.action: Record the actual test result shown in the system. Do not classify by guess; continue DSL/ADSL checks if only internet is affected, or consult the current landline procedure.
voice_verify_unknown.customer_script: I could not confirm the dial tone now; I will check the line status and continue with the right checks.
voice_verify_unknown.sla: Based on the test result and current system

connection_check.question: Confirm the router is connected directly to the main line socket, without internal extensions or an extra splitter. Was this tested?
connection_check.customer_prompt: Disconnect internal extensions/splitters, connect the router directly to the main socket, then check the DSL/ADSL light.

options.label: Yes, directly on the main socket; no internal extensions
There was an internal extension; tested from the main socket
Cannot test or main socket is unclear

connection_unknown_terminal.question: Internal wiring has not been ruled out.
connection_unknown_terminal.action: Record that a direct test was not completed. Do not claim internal wiring was fixed or confirmed as the cause without an actual result. Follow the approved wiring check or continue after testing the main socket.
connection_unknown_terminal.customer_script: Before I identify the cause, we need to test the router directly on the main socket and check the wiring.
connection_unknown_terminal.sla: Do not classify until checks are complete

physical_iu_terminal.question: The Physical Instability complaint is routed to IU.
physical_iu_terminal.action: Run the ASSIA check and review Outage/special SLA status, then open or update the correct TT. The training reference for IU Physical Instability is 24 hours. Read the actual case SLA from the system; do not quote two hours because that applies to NOC follow-up after resolution. Record the complaint number and give it to the customer with the displayed SLA.
physical_iu_terminal.customer_script: Your physical-fault complaint reference is (TT number from the system), and the recorded SLA is (displayed SLA). We will follow up using the same complaint reference.
physical_iu_terminal.reference_guidance: Give the TT/complaint reference and actual SLA. Do not share an internal IR number; share an SR only if it has a customer-facing reference.
physical_iu_terminal.sla: 24 hours is the standard IU reference; verify the actual case and any exception in the system.

noc_oncall_availability.question: Is the customer available to receive a NOC follow-up call between 10 PM and 8 AM?
noc_oncall_availability.customer_prompt: Would you be available to receive a follow-up call from the specialist team between 10 PM and 8 AM?

noc_oncall_available_terminal.question: The customer is available for NOC follow-up overnight.
noc_oncall_available_terminal.action: Create/update IR as required, select Case Type: On Call (To SLS), and add all completed troubleshooting steps. Update the TT/complaint and read its actual resolution SLA. Tell the customer the follow-up call is expected within two hours after the issue is resolved; do not promise the repair itself within two hours. Record the customer-facing TT number and keep the IR number internal.
noc_oncall_available_terminal.customer_script: Your complaint/TT reference is (system number). The specialist team will call within two hours after the issue is resolved. The recorded resolution SLA is (read the TT SLA as shown).
noc_oncall_available_terminal.reference_guidance: Give the TT/complaint reference and actual SLA. Do not share IR unless the system provides a customer-facing reference.
noc_oncall_available_terminal.sla: NOC call within two hours after resolution; read the case-resolution SLA from the TT.

noc_oncall_unavailable_terminal.question: The customer is unavailable for NOC follow-up overnight.
noc_oncall_unavailable_terminal.action: Do not select On Call (To SLS) without the customer’s availability. Update the TT/complaint with the correct process and record its number and actual SLA. Tell the customer the team will follow up after 8 AM. Do not share internal IR numbers.
noc_oncall_unavailable_terminal.customer_script: Your complaint/TT reference is (system number), and the recorded case SLA is (read the TT SLA). Since you are unavailable for a night call, the team will follow up after 8 AM.
noc_oncall_unavailable_terminal.reference_guidance: Give the TT/complaint reference and actual SLA, and clarify follow-up after 8 AM. Do not share internal IR.
noc_oncall_unavailable_terminal.sla: Follow-up after 8 AM if unavailable overnight; case-resolution SLA is the one on the TT.

noc_standard_terminal.question: The NOC path does not require overnight On Call handling.
noc_standard_terminal.action: Update the TT/complaint with troubleshooting results and record its number and displayed SLA. The training guide says NOC follow-up is within two hours after the issue is resolved; tell the customer the actual case-resolution SLA separately. Do not share internal IR numbers.
noc_standard_terminal.customer_script: Your complaint/TT reference is (system number), and the recorded resolution SLA is (read it). The NOC team will call within two hours after the issue is resolved.
noc_standard_terminal.reference_guidance: Give the TT/complaint reference and displayed SLA. Distinguish the resolution SLA from the follow-up call after resolution. Do not share internal IR.
noc_standard_terminal.sla: Resolution SLA: read the TT. NOC follow-up: within two hours after the issue is resolved per the training guide.

Other product or offer (Sonic / MIX / Life / bundles...)
